paper_title: Rethinking the Role of Prompting Strategies in LLM Test-Time Scaling A   Perspective of Probability Theory
caption: Results of combining adaptively scaling and dynamically choosing the optimal i on GLM-4-9B-Instruct on MATH.

model_annotations.Bulgarian:
The figure illustrates the relationship between sampling time and accuracy for various prompting strategies, comparing their performance over a range of sampling times. 

The X-axis is labeled "Sampling Time", has a linear scale, and spans from 0 to 70, with major ticks at intervals of 10 and minor ticks at intervals of 5. The Y-axis is labeled "Accuracy", has a linear scale, and ranges from 45 to 85, with major ticks at intervals of 5.

The graph includes six distinct lines, each representing a different prompting strategy: DiP (purple, triangle marker, solid line), AnP (orange, triangle marker, solid line), CoT (blue, triangle marker, solid line), Dynamic w/ Oracle (black, square marker, dashed line), L2M (cyan, triangle marker, solid line), and SBP (light orange, triangle marker, solid line), as well as Adaptive + Dynamic w/ Oracle (red, circle marker, dashed line). 

The DiP line starts at an accuracy of around 50 at a sampling time of 0, increases to around 62 at a sampling time of 20, and then remains relatively stable until a sampling time of 70. The AnP line begins at an accuracy of around 45 at a sampling time of 0, rises to approximately 60 at a sampling time of 20, and then levels off. The CoT line commences at an accuracy of around 50 at a sampling time of 0, climbs to about 62 at a sampling time of 20, and stabilizes thereafter. The Dynamic w/ Oracle line starts at an accuracy of around 73 at a sampling time of 0, experiences a slight dip before stabilizing around 74 between sampling times of 10 and 70. The L2M line initiates at an accuracy of around 50 at a sampling time of 0, ascends to roughly 62 at a sampling time of 20, and then plateaus. The SBP line begins at an accuracy of around 55 at a sampling time of 5, increases to approximately 62 at a sampling time of 20, and remains steady. The Adaptive + Dynamic w/ Oracle line starts at an accuracy of around 74 at a sampling time of 0, continues to rise to around 84 at a sampling time of 30, and then levels off until a sampling time of 70.

"AnP" is represented by a solid orange line with square markers, showing a more gradual increase, starting at around (0, 45) and ending at approximately (70, 59).
